class.name: HTMLOListElement
class.brief_description: A handle to an HTML ordered list.
class.description: Represents an [code]<ol>[/code] element. Changing its reflected attributes updates the markers on the next layout.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the [code]reversed[/code] attribute is present and numbering counts down.
The first item number. Reading a missing or invalid [code]start[/code] attribute returns [code]1[/code]. A reversed list with no explicit start counts down from its number of items when rendered.
The reflected marker type. Values [code]1[/code], [code]a[/code], [code]A[/code], [code]i[/code], and [code]I[/code] set the default numbering style. CSS can override it.
